# Agile modification record

WePLD imported pinned `github/spec-kit` revision `27f50f7e6b618ea14d74dd4037f9e7c60218b16c` on 2026-08-23. The deterministic rebrand maps the distribution to `wepld-agile`, the module namespace to `agile_cli`, the CLI to `agile`, and the product capability to Agile. Upstream logo/demo/video binary branding was replaced with WePLD-owned Agile artwork. The MIT license is preserved verbatim; the source map records every resulting object.
